metadata.heading_title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

heading.title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

article.title: 1 [Right of redeeming co-mortgagor to expenses.
article.content:
951[Right of redeeming co-mortgagor to expenses.

Section 95  ·  Chapter IV  ·  Redemption  ·  page 36 of the Act
Where one of several mortgagors redeems the mortgaged property, he shall, in enforcing his right of subrogation under section 92 against his co-mortgagors, be entitled to add to the mortgage-money recoverable from them such proportion of the expenses properly incurred in such redemption as is attributable to their share in the property.
1 Subs. by Act 20 of 1929, s. 48, for s. 95. Original s. 96 was rep. by Act 5 of 1908, s. 156 and Sch. V.
